positive.prompt: Which skill should I use for this task?
How do I decide which workflow applies to this piece of work?
Route this request to the right skill in the pack

negative.prompt: Debug the null pointer crash in checkout
Make the modal accessible for keyboard users

evals.prompt: A user asks: 'the login page is broken after yesterday's deploy'. Decide which skill applies and why.
evals.expected_output: Correct routing through the decision tree with the chosen skill and rationale
expectations: The chosen skill matches the decision tree in the meta-skill
The rationale references the routing logic rather than guessing
Core operating behaviors (assumptions surfaced) are respected

evals.prompt: The available pack contains only the listed engineering skills. A user asks you to translate a short restaurant menu. Decide whether any skill is needed and perform only the authorized translation. Do not invent a new engineering workflow or choose the nearest domain merely because no exact skill exists.
evals.expected_output: A direct answer or a concise statement that no engineering skill fits; no unrelated lifecycle work
expectations: No unrelated engineering skill, new specification, test suite or review team is started
The result recognizes that no available skill is an appropriate match
The user is not asked to approve routine work that was already authorized
